Requests:
[t0] I am requesting deletion of the account registered to this email address. Please include information linked through current or earlier account identifiers. Let me know when the request has been completed.
[t1] I am requesting deletion of the account registered to this email address. Please include information linked through current or earlier account identifiers. Please confirm the result after completing the required checks.
[t2] I am requesting deletion of the account registered to this email address. Please include information linked through current or earlier account identifiers. Please confirm when the review is complete.
[t3] I am requesting deletion of the account registered to this email address. Please include information linked through current or earlier account identifiers. Please contact me if you need information to verify the request.
[t4] I am requesting deletion of the account registered to this email address. Please include records associated with the account under your privacy process. Please confirm when the review is complete.
[t5] I am requesting deletion of the account registered to this email address. Please include records associated with the account under your privacy process. Please contact me if you need information to verify the request.
[t6] I am requesting deletion of the account registered to this email address. Please process this under the standard personal-data deletion procedure. Let me know when the request has been completed.
[t7] I am requesting deletion of the account registered to this email address. Please process this under the standard personal-data deletion procedure. Please confirm the result after completing the required checks.
[t8] I am requesting deletion of the account registered to this email address. Please review any identifiers connected to this account as part of the request. I would appreciate confirmation of the final outcome.
[t9] I am requesting deletion of the account registered to this email address. Please review any identifiers connected to this account as part of the request. Let me know when the request has been completed.
[t10] I am requesting deletion of the account registered to this email address. Please review any identifiers connected to this account as part of the request. Please let me know once the request has been reviewed.
[t11] I am requesting deletion of the account registered to this email address. Please review the account data that is eligible for deletion or de-identification. A short confirmation when the process is complete is sufficient.
[t12] I can't access my profile and need help resetting the login. Do not close the account.
[t13] I changed the email on this account before deleting it. Please check that nothing tied to the old address was left behind, even in systems that do not display the email.
[t14] I closed my account, but an old “download your data” link still works. Please delete that export file as well.
[t15] I deleted my account and received the confirmation email. Could you verify that the profile is gone and that anything retained for security is limited to what is required?
[t16] I deleted this account and received a confirmation, but the same email address is still recognized. Please remove any remaining copy of my profile.
[t17] I disconnected my account last week, but one of the integrations still seems active. Close the account completely and make sure it can no longer send my data to other systems.
[t18] I found an old report saying my account still existed. Please check the latest state and confirm that the profile is gone and that remaining records cannot identify me.
[t19] I need a copy of last year's invoices for my records. Please leave my profile and purchase history in place.
[t20] I no longer need this account. Please remove my name and contact details, but keeping an internal deleted-account reference is fine if other required records still depend on it.
[t21] I no longer use this account and would like it permanently deleted. Please apply the correct treatment to records covered by the request. A short confirmation when the process is complete is sufficient.
[t22] I no longer use this account and would like it permanently deleted. Please apply the request across the systems covered by your deletion policy. Please send a confirmation after the process finishes.
[t23] I no longer use this account and would like it permanently deleted. Please check the records connected to the account before confirming completion. I would appreciate confirmation of the final outcome.
[t24] I no longer use this account and would like it permanently deleted. Please check the records connected to the account before confirming completion. Please confirm the result after completing the required checks.
[t25] I no longer use this account and would like it permanently deleted. Please check the records connected to the account before confirming completion. Please let me know once the request has been reviewed.
[t26] I no longer use this account and would like it permanently deleted. Please complete the normal identity and data review for this request. Let me know when the request has been completed.
[t27] I no longer use this account and would like it permanently deleted. Please complete the normal identity and data review for this request. Please let me know once the request has been reviewed.
[t28] I no longer use this account and would like it permanently deleted. Please ensure the request is applied to the relevant account records. A short confirmation when the process is complete is sufficient.
[t29] I no longer use this account and would like it permanently deleted. Please ensure the request is applied to the relevant account records. I would appreciate confirmation of the final outcome.
